Witnesses reported that Dooley asked the girl if she "had the gun" before his departure, though police found only a pillow and a green blanket in her possession. Bystanders contacted law enforcement after Dooley failed to return, leading to his arrest when he reappeared at the store.

The automated border management system is designed to track non-EU travelers, but its rocky rollout has repeatedly disrupted transport networks and passenger processing.
